doc.title: Related Reports
doc.summary: This document outlines various reports available within the Digii platform related to mess and meal consumption, providing detailed insights into individual and consolidated usage patterns for monitoring and analysis.

chunks.what_it_does: This report provides a consolidated summary of the number of meals consumed by a user for the selected year and month.
chunks.why_it_matters: It helps track individual meal consumption over the course of the month for monitoring and analysis purposes.
how_to_use: Available in the Mess Management Module under Vision tab.

chunks.what_it_does: This report provides meal-wise data for a selected date, showing the total number of coupons availed for each meal type.
chunks.why_it_matters: It helps track how many meals were consumed by each individual on that particular day for monitoring and analysis purposes.
how_to_use: Available in the Mess Management Module under Vision tab.

chunks.what_it_does: This report provides a comprehensive breakdown of meal consumption at an individual user level, capturing the total count of each meal type availed by a student based on institutional meal configuration.
chunks.why_it_matters: It offers a clear and detailed view of individual mess usage, helping understand student meal preferences and consumption patterns.
how_to_use: This report is available in the Analytics module under the Hostel section in the Mess tab.
examples: If a university has three meal types configured like Breakfast, Lunch, and Dinner, this report will display the total number of times each meal has been availed by the respective student.

chunks.what_it_does: This report provides a detailed record of meal consumption at an individual level, tracking which user availed which meal, at which mess, and on what date, along with the admin responsible for enabling the coupon.
chunks.why_it_matters: It supports mess utilization monitoring, user-type segmentation, and admin accountability, serving as a reliable reference for auditing meal activity and understanding overall mess usage patterns across the institution.
how_to_use: This report is available in the Analytics module under the Hostel section in the Mess tab.
examples: Administrators can track which user availed which meal, at which mess, and on what date — along with the admin responsible for enabling the coupon.
